label: vLLM config 3 stress: Qwen TP2 + 0.6B emb TP2
chat_server_config:
# vllm serve --config for Qwen3.8-27B on both GPUs (tensor parallelism) next to the embedding model
# (config-embedding-tp2-qwen.yaml): configuration 3. The same as config-qwen3.8-27b-tp2.yaml, except for the
# memory settings. Benchmarks: README.md
# AWQ int4 with group size 32 (asymmetric, MSE observer); the Gated DeltaNet layers, the embedding, the lm_head and
# the MTP head are BF16. 19.6 GiB in total, 9.3 GiB per GPU without the vision tower.
model: cyankiwi/Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4
served-model-name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
tensor-parallel-size: 2
# Peer-to-peer copies between the GPUs return corrupted data on this machine, so the custom all-reduce (which uses
# them) spins forever. NCCL without P2P (NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 in docker-compose.yml) is used instead.
disable-custom-all-reduce: true
# Do not load the vision tower, which would take memory from the KV cache.
language-model-only: true
max-model-len: 73728
# Set explicitly, as gpu-memory-utilization would also count the memory of the embedding server.
# vLLM still requires this fraction of the GPU memory to be free at startup, so it has to be lower than what the
# embedding server leaves free (~14.1 of 15.6 GiB).
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
kv-cache-memory-bytes: 3000000000
# PaperQA2 sends 4 concurrent requests by default (PAPERQA_CONCURRENCY in paperqa_ask.py). Every sequence needs its
# own recurrent state for the 48 Gated DeltaNet layers.
max-num-seqs: 4
# The prefill chunk. Larger chunks need more activation memory.
max-num-batched-tokens: 1024
# CUDA graphs only for decoding and the batch sizes of 4 sequences with 2 drafted tokens each.
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY", "cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12]}
enable-prefix-caching: true
# Prefix cache blocks evicted from the GPU are kept in pinned RAM, so that the excerpts of the papers that PaperQA2
# summarizes again for the next question need no new prompt processing.
kv-offloading-size: 8
kv-offloading-backend: native
# Speculative decoding with the model's own MTP head: chat 37.5 -> 55.4 t/s.
speculative-config: {"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}
reasoning-parser: qwen3
enable-auto-tool-choice: true
tool-call-parser: qwen3_coder
# Sampling: generation_config.json of the model (temperature 1.0, top-k 20, top-p 0.95), as recommended by Qwen.

# FlashAttention 2 (the default on Ampere) supports no quantized KV cache. int8 with a scale per token and head
# (the format closest to llama.cpp's q8_0) with Triton attention fits twice the context of BF16.

chat_server_config:
version = 1

; Gemma 4 26B-A4B QAT and the embedding model on both GPUs.
; The VRAM, speed and PaperQA2 results, also with some experts on the CPU, are in README.md.

[google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat]
hf = unsloth/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
; Host RAM for saving the prompt caches of conversations that are not in a slot (default 8192 MiB).
cache-ram = 16384
; The model's maximum. The KV cache takes 20 KiB per token (5 GiB), shared by the slots (kv-unified in config.ini).
ctx-size = 262144
fit = off
flash-attn = on
load-mode = mmap
load-on-startup = true
n-gpu-layers = all
no-mmproj-offload = 1
; PaperQA2 sends up to 4 concurrent requests by default (answer.max_concurrent_requests).
parallel = 4
spec-type = draft-mtp
spec-draft-n-max = 2
split-mode = layer
tensor-split = 4,3
ubatch-size = 1024
; Model parameters
; https://unsloth.ai/docs/models/gemma-4/qat#llama-server-deployment
temp = 1.0
top-k = 64
top-p = 0.95

[Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B]
; The 4B model retrieved as well as the 8B model (Q6_K) on the PaperQA2 corpus, at 1.6 times the speed and with
; 1.5 GiB less VRAM per GPU, which the NCCL all-reduce of the tensor split (since ~b11500) and the context of the LLM
; need. See ../vllm-big-machine/README.md#embedding-models. Changing the model starts a new PaperQA2 index.
hf = Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B-GGUF:Q6_K
; PaperQA2 uses 5000-character chunks (parsing.reader_config chunk_chars) by default, which is ~1100 tokens of
; PDF text and up to ~3500 tokens for reference lists and tables. A single input larger than ubatch-size is processed

label: vLLM config 3 stress after compose up (simultaneous start)
chat_server_config:
# vllm serve --config for Qwen3.8-27B on both GPUs (tensor parallelism) next to the embedding model
# (config-embedding-tp2-qwen.yaml): configuration 3. The same as config-qwen3.8-27b-tp2.yaml, except for the
# memory settings. Benchmarks: README.md
# AWQ int4 with group size 32 (asymmetric, MSE observer); the Gated DeltaNet layers, the embedding, the lm_head and
# the MTP head are BF16. 19.6 GiB in total, 9.3 GiB per GPU without the vision tower.
model: cyankiwi/Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4
served-model-name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
tensor-parallel-size: 2
# Peer-to-peer copies between the GPUs return corrupted data on this machine, so the custom all-reduce (which uses
# them) spins forever. NCCL without P2P (NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 in docker-compose.yml) is used instead.
disable-custom-all-reduce: true
# Do not load the vision tower, which would take memory from the KV cache.
language-model-only: true
max-model-len: 94208
# Set explicitly, as gpu-memory-utilization would also count the memory of the embedding server.
# vLLM still requires this fraction of the GPU memory to be free at startup, so it has to be lower than what the
# embedding server leaves free (~14.1 of 15.6 GiB).
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
kv-cache-memory-bytes: 3900000000
# PaperQA2 sends 4 concurrent requests by default (PAPERQA_CONCURRENCY in paperqa_ask.py). Every sequence needs its
# own recurrent state for the 48 Gated DeltaNet layers.
max-num-seqs: 4
# The prefill chunk. Larger chunks need more activation memory.
max-num-batched-tokens: 1024
# CUDA graphs only for decoding and the batch sizes of 4 sequences with 2 drafted tokens each.
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY", "cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12]}
enable-prefix-caching: true
# Prefix cache blocks evicted from the GPU are kept in pinned RAM, so that the excerpts of the papers that PaperQA2
# summarizes again for the next question need no new prompt processing.
kv-offloading-size: 8
kv-offloading-backend: native
# Speculative decoding with the model's own MTP head: chat 37.5 -> 55.4 t/s.
speculative-config: {"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}
reasoning-parser: qwen3
enable-auto-tool-choice: true
tool-call-parser: qwen3_coder
# Sampling: generation_config.json of the model (temperature 1.0, top-k 20, top-p 0.95), as recommended by Qwen.
